name: Crack a fetch on turn 1-2 for a land that unlocks a hand card
intent: On turn 1 or 2, once open-land-unlocks has had first refusal, play a fetch from hand and crack it for whatever land in the library would unlock some other hand card - Polluted Delta found for a library Swamp that lets Thoughtseize be cast. play_land's own prefer is three tiers: first, a fetch that both reaches a basic unlock (unlocks_by_basic_search) AND carries Plains in its own search template - dimir-frog has no basic Plains at all, so that half of Flooded Strand's/Marsh Flats' template is always dead weight, and conserving the fetch with no dead half (Polluted Delta, 2 Island/1 Swamp both live) for later is worth more than spending it now; second, any fetch that reaches a basic unlock at all, once the first tier narrows nothing (no candidate carries Plains); third, the bare Plains-template tier as a last-resort fallback. Hands: Strand+Delta+Thoughtseize (library Swamp) - Strand cannot reach Swamp at all (select excludes it), so Delta is the only candidate regardless of prefer. Strand+Flats+Thoughtseize (library Swamp) - Strand again excluded, Flats is the only candidate. Triggers on unlocks_by_basic_search, not the broader unlocks_by_search (review item 3): a fetch that can only reach a non-basic unlock (a shockland the library holds but no basic) never makes this play apply at all - open-fetch-unlocks-shock covers exactly that case instead, paying the shock's own 2 life on top of the fetch's. The crack itself is restricted to an untapped source that can actually reach a basic unlock (searches_for_any plus unlocks_by_basic_search), so a stale fetch already on the battlefield that cannot reach the needed basic is never cracked in place of the one that can. Its own choose_cards pick prefers a basic first (never spend life when a free basic unlocks the same thing), then a shockland, paying life only when the fetch's own find needs it. Stands down once open-land-unlocks would already fire (U's own key), at 7 life or less, and once the library is down to 5 cards or fewer. Against boros-aggro, boros-energy and ur-cutter-prowess this stands down entirely (open-fetch-unlocks-basic, never paying life, covers the same need there instead) - the same reasoning as open-shock-unlocks. Only turns 1-2, land drop available, mine, precombat main, empty stack.
